criteria.given: I am authenticated as an administrator
criteria.when: I trigger the user export from the admin panel
criteria.then: a CSV file is generated containing every active (non-deleted) user account with HTTP 200

criteria.given: I am authenticated as an administrator and at least one user is soft-deleted
criteria.then: soft-deleted users are excluded from the resulting CSV

criteria.given: I am authenticated as a non-administrator
criteria.when: I attempt to trigger the user export
criteria.then: the server responds with HTTP 403 and no file is generated
